activePortraitSweep.caveat: Prioritizes continuous motion; active CPU exceeds the old <8% target. Not an idle CPU sample.

foregroundStability.caveat: The 600-second sample includes extra unscripted photo changes and lacks an end-of-sample page snapshot. It is a foreground stability sample, not an isolated ten-minute gallery/idle CPU measurement.
